paragraphs.text: Te Ju Ki was an old holy elder human on Dominaria . She became Ugin 's mentor.

Te Ju Ki's sole purpose in life was to think about things that could not be seen. She lived alone in a round chamber with stone slab walls. Like the stone, she was tough and dry. Though she was withered of limb and frail of body, her mind was as sharp as obsidian. She knew many schemes as an aid to meditation.
Young Ugin befriended her and soaked up the calm wisdom she exuded. From her, he learned about the existence of other planes . His twin Nicol had no patience for Te Ju Ki's lessons.
